baseline.conditions: Canal service road with one staffed overnight yard.

title: A bed at the junction
daily_life: The canal service road carries repair pieces too awkward to ship on the day’s boat. Its staffed overnight yard is ordinary infrastructure maintained by people with work of their own.
timing: One staffed overnight yard is established. A three-day road journey still needs a second overnight arrangement; it may be an inspected temporary camp, not a newly named permanent settlement.
handoff: The yard registers the chosen next leg rather than assuming all arrivals continue by road. Transfer to WAY-03 is a separate decision, with separate timing.
story_option: The last sheltered place belongs to a small party. A larger convoy has to divide its loads and book later departures instead of silently occupying someone else’s space.
production: Use a reusable camp dressing for the unregistered halt; log weather, water and who stayed awake. Do not add a city to fill a timing gap.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
